tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Creates the company in Guest Logic (a hotel in free test mode) and e-mails the owner one approval link. Use only when the owner has no Guest Logic account. The reply names everything still missing and the tool that fills each. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: my_hotel
tools.description: The hotel's details: name, address, phone, rooms, check-in and check-out, taxes, and whether it is in test mode. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: Every fact this company needs, each Done, Missing, Needs us or Optional, with the tool that fills each missing one. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: set_company
tools.description: The legal name, mailing address, billing e-mail, website and time zone. Send only what you have. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: set_venue
tools.description: The event spaces and how many each holds, shown on quotes and the inquiry form. Replaces the list. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: set_hiring
tools.description: The positions hired for (shown on the company's careers page), the hiring e-mail and the hiring phone. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: set_team
tools.description: E-mails a sign-in to each team member, up to 25 a call. Reports the result per person. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: For a PDF, picture or spreadsheet (up to 25 MB). Call with filename, content_type and size: you get an address to PUT the file to. After the PUT, call again with document_id: Guest Logic reads it and returns what was found. Types: PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, XLSX, XLS, CSV, TXT. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: request_go_live
tools.description: Files the request to go live once the legal name, address, billing e-mail and the owner's accepted agreement are in; otherwise names what is missing. The Guest Logic team presses the last button. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: upload_report
tools.description: Sends one report's content as text (CSV, tab-separated or plain text, up to 4 MB) — read a PDF or spreadsheet first and send its rows. Guest Logic reads it and sets up what it can (rooms, room types, rates, taxes, stays). Returns what was found. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: submit_facts
tools.description: Rooms and stays you already extracted, as rows. Guest Logic applies them by the same rules as an uploaded report. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: confirm_facts
tools.description: Confirms or changes one setup step. step and values: hotel {name, phone, email} · taxes {state, tourism, other} as percentages · checkin {check_in, check_out} as HH:MM · policies {cancellation, deposit, noshow, pets, smoking} · room_types {CODE: {name, sleeps}} · rates {CODE: nightly rate} · rooms (

tools.name: load_stays
tools.description: Loads the stays read from the reports into the hotel. First call without confirm to see the rows that need a decision; show them to the owner; then call with confirm true. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: add_photo
tools.description: Adds a picture from a public web address (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB) to the booking page: the hotel, or one room type. 40 a day while testing. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: set_logo
tools.description: Sets the company's logo from a public web address (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB). Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: drop_link
tools.description: The owner's links to drop files you cannot send as text (a scanned PDF) and to manage photos. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: ask_us
tools.description: Asks the Guest Logic team to connect card payments, Expedia and Booking.com, or to finish the whole setup by hand. Connected within 24 hours. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: invite_staff
tools.description: E-mails a sign-in to an employee or a manager. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: stays
tools.description: Stays touching a date range (up to 31 days): confirmation, guest, dates, room, type, status, rate, source. Up to 200 rows a call; use page for more. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: stay
tools.description: One stay by its confirmation number. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: availability
tools.description: Rooms free each night by room type for a date range (up to 31 days). Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: house_inventory
tools.description: For one day: arrivals, departures, in house, rooms by housekeeping status, rooms out of order. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: The company's automations: what each sends, when, and whether it is on. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: automation_status
tools.description: The last runs of the company's automations: when, result, error. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: tasks_waiting_on_me
tools.description: Open tasks on the signed-in person's Home board. Needs the owner's sign-in.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: confirm_facts · Private data: upload_file, request_go_live, drop_link · Public sink: set_company, upload_file, upload_report, submit_facts, confirm_facts, drop_link · Destructive: drop_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: confirm_facts · Private data: upload_file, request_go_live, drop_link · Public sink: set_company, upload_file, upload_report, submit_facts, confirm_facts, drop_link · Destructive: drop_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
